caseName: Board of Education v. Newburg Area Council, Inc.
caseNameFull: Board of Education of Jefferson County, Kentucky v. Newburg Area Council, Inc. Board of Education of Louisville, Kentucky v. Haycraft and Board of Education of Anchorage, Kentucky v. Haycraft
judges: Brennan, Briefing, Certiorari, Douglas, Judgments, White, Would

opinions.text:
C. A. 6th Cir. Petitions for writs of certiorari granted. Judgments vacated and cases remanded for further consideration in light of Milliken v. Bradley, ante, p. 717.

Mr. Justice Douglas, Mr. Justice Brennan, Mr. Justice White, *919and Mr. Justice Marshall would grant certiorari and, without further briefing or oral argument, would affirm the judgments.

Reported below: 489 F. 2d 925.
